## Accuracy checklist

- [ ] Template fields and checked boxes are claims for reviewers and gates to
      verify, not evidence by themselves.
- [ ] The actual diff stays within the declared or explicitly revised scope.
- [ ] Tests are tied to changed behavior, not only to changed filenames.
- [ ] Mock-only or Agent self-reported output is not presented as assembled or
      external evidence.
- [ ] Pending, skipped, historical, different-SHA, source-only, and runtime
      evidence retain distinct labels.
- [ ] `Closes`/`Fixes` is used only when merge satisfies the linked acceptance
      and review requirements.
